description: (Note: Potential building works nuisances during week days) A rare gem in Paris, spacious, and perfectly placed in the Triangle d’Or, just steps from Avenue Montaigne. Quiet and serene despite the central location, the apartment is filled with natural light and features a generous living area. This stylish 3-bedroom home sleeps up to 6 guests, with each bedroom offering its own bathroom for convenience. The perfect base for enjoying Parisian experience.The spaceStep inside this exquisite Parisian apartment and discover a haven of comfort and style. The apartment features three beautifully appointed bedrooms and a spacious living area, offering ample space for up to 8 guests. * Bedroom 1 features a luxurious king-size bed, and ample storage* Bedroom 2 features a king-size bed, and walking closet. Ensuite bathroom.* Bedroom 3 is features double bed, perfect for additional guests or kids.* The living room provides a cozy space to relax and a sofa bed that can accommodate more travellers.* Three full bathrooms, ensuring convenience and privacy for all. * A fully equipped kitchen, featuring modern appliances and all the essentials.Guest accessFull access to the apartment for a fully independent stay.Other things to note* 155 sqm (1669 sq.ft)* High-speed Wi-Fi* Elevator access * Baby crib provided* Quiet building* Three bedrooms (6 guests)* Bed linen, towels, and toiletries provided* Private driver / airport transfer on requestPlease contact us for any additional requests.We look forward to hosting you!
